name: Partner
source:
Main character works for a top trading company. He is assigned to the Energy Fuel Department which is the main division of the company. However, internal situation in the department is complex and full of distrust and envy. Is it possible for him to survive here? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一家顶级贸易公司工作，被分配到作为公司核心部门的能源燃料部。然而，部门内部局势复杂，充满不信任与嫉妒。他能够在这里生存下去吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
